timingcheck.reason: Icarus Verilog implements SDF delay annotation (IOPATH/INTERCONNECT) but not SDF TIMINGCHECK -- every TIMINGCHECK section in the SDF is dropped, so $setup/$hold/$width checks run against the cell library's own placeholder timing, not the characterised limits in the SDF
